_note: OCA hierarch-commemoration derivation. Produces every overlay key that names the parish's hierarchs from 4 form fields: primate_name + ruling_hierarch_name (full titles, used in Anaphora) and primate_short + ruling_hierarch_short (short forms like 'Metropolitan Tikhon', used in litanies). Phase 2 leftover landed the short-form fields and extended coverage to greatLitany / augmentedLitany / litya across both Liturgy and Vespers.

keys.liturgy:anaphora-chrysostom.commemoratio: Among the first, remember, O Lord, His Beatitude, the Most Blessed {primate_name}; and His Eminence, the Most Reverend {ruling_hierarch_name}. Grant them for Thy Holy Churches in peace, safety, honor, health, and length of days, rightly to divide the word of Thy truth.
keys.liturgy:anaphora-basil.commemoration-hie: Among the first, remember, O Lord, His Beatitude, the Most Blessed {primate_name}; and His Eminence, the Most Reverend {ruling_hierarch_name}. Grant them for Thy Holy Churches in peace, safety, honor, health, and length of days, rightly to divide the word of Thy truth.
keys.liturgy:hierarch-commemoration.greatLita: For the most blessed {primate_short}, most reverend {ruling_hierarch_short}, for the honorable presbytery, the diaconate in Christ, all the clergy and the people, let us pray to the Lord.
keys.liturgy:hierarch-commemoration.augmented: Again we pray for the most blessed {primate_short}, and for the most reverend {ruling_hierarch_short}.
keys.vespers:hierarch-commemoration.greatLita: For the most blessed {primate_short}, most reverend {ruling_hierarch_short}, for the honorable presbytery, the diaconate in Christ, all the clergy and the people, let us pray to the Lord.
keys.vespers:hierarch-commemoration.augmented: Again we pray for the most blessed {primate_short}, and for the most reverend {ruling_hierarch_short}.
keys.vespers:hierarch-commemoration.litya: Again we pray for the most blessed {primate_short}, and for the most reverend {ruling_hierarch_short}.
